svg.title: Performance across model families
svg.desc: Four independent benchmark snapshots: Qwen3-4B median token latency with and without DSpark; Qwen3.5-9B and 27B throughput versus concurrency; Gemma 4 26B-A4B end-to-end latency relative to vLLM with BF16 or default FP8 KV; GLM-5.2 throughput on four versus eight GB300 GPUs. PegaInfer uses BF16 KV in both Gemma comparisons, which were measured separately. Hardware, workloads and axes differ between panels. Source measurements are embedded in metadata.
